scope: Current UK personal credit-card products from official issuer sources only. Introductory offers are not represented as ongoing rewards.

publishability_definitions.rankable: The issuer publishes a deterministic ongoing purchase reward that can be represented without inventing a monetary value.
publishability_definitions.identity_only: The product is useful for wallet selection, but must not enter value ranking without additional user state or a reviewed valuation.
publishability_definitions.exclude: Do not publish until the ambiguity in the record is resolved.
